criteria.description: Computes the marginal cost per unit of value (e.g. cost per draft from token/inference usage) before recommending a price, with stated assumptions.
Chooses a pricing structure deliberately (per-seat / usage / tiered with allowance+overage / outcome) and justifies it against alternatives.
Tests margin across the usage distribution, especially the heavy user, rather than only the average — ensuring no segment is underwater.
Includes guardrails that protect margin (included allowance, overage, fair-use cap, or rate limit).
Cross-checks price against the value delivered / willingness-to-pay / next-best alternative, not just cost-plus.
Considers that model/inference costs change over time and how that affects margin or price.
